name: subauth
description: Subscription auth for AI providers — use a personal ChatGPT subscription as an OpenAI-compatible credential. Personal, single-account use only.
//publish-guards: Publishing this to a registry would hand strangers a one-line way to route requests through a personal subscription — the pattern providers act against first — and npm's unpublish window is 72 hours. Two independent guards, because `private` is one deleted line: npm refuses a private package with EPRIVATE before any upload, and `prepublishOnly` fails the publish even if `private` is gone. Neither affects `github:` installs. See docs/personal-use.md.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('subauth is distributed by git tag only and is never published to a registry. See docs/personal-use.md.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.test:consumer: node test/consumer/ac1-refresh.cjs && node test/consumer/ac2-entries.mjs && node test/consumer/ac3-codex-fetch.cjs && node test/consumer/ac4-no-leak.cjs && node test/consumer/ac5-node10.cjs && node test/consumer/ac6-dual-instance.mjs && node test/consumer/ac7-tag-install.cjs && node test/consumer/ac8-codex-auth.cjs && node test/consumer/ac9-codex-cli-roundtrip.cjs && node test/consumer/ac10-malformed-200.cjs && node test/consumer/ac11-scratch-cleanup.cjs && node test/consumer/ac12-publish-blocked.cjs && node test/consumer/ac13-worker-writes.cjs
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:consumer
